cases.name: query-only normal route
cases.prompt: Calculate the normal route from Jita to Amarr and do not display it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Return the calculation without creating map state.

cases.name: visual normal mission
cases.prompt: Create Delve Move, show a normal route, add rally and destination markers, show a 5 LY range, and fit the mission.

cases.name: visual capital mission
cases.prompt: Create Capital Test and display a capital route with an explicit effective range, then fit the mission.
cases.expectedBehavior: Create only a temporary capital-route Mission.

cases.name: disconnected safety
cases.prompt: AI Control is disconnected; change the map through another mechanism.
cases.expectedBehavior: Report the disconnected session and do not use a fallback control path.

cases.name: temporary marker default
cases.expectedBehavior: Create a temporary Mission Marker, not a Saved Marker.

cases.name: explicit permanent marker
cases.expectedBehavior: Create one persistent Saved Marker with AI provenance.

cases.name: saved marker permission denied
cases.prompt: Save Jita permanently as Logistics while Saved Marker access is disabled.
cases.expectedBehavior: Report CAPABILITY_DENIED and explicitly say no permanent marker was created.

cases.name: saved marker duplicate
cases.prompt: Permanently save another marker on a system that already has one.
cases.expectedBehavior: Report MARKER_ALREADY_EXISTS and do not overwrite the existing marker.

cases.name: saved and Mission marker query
cases.prompt: What markers do I have on 1DQ?
cases.expectedBehavior: Distinguish the persistent Saved Marker from session-only Mission Markers.

cases.name: ambiguous remember stays temporary
cases.expectedBehavior: Treat ambiguous remember wording as a temporary Mission Marker.

cases.name: saved marker mutation protection
cases.prompt: Delete my saved marker and replace its tags.
cases.expectedBehavior: Explain that Saved Marker update, delete, replace, and existing-tag operations are unavailable.

cases.name: explicit saved marker tags
cases.prompt: Save 1DQ permanently with staging and strategic tags.
cases.expectedBehavior: Create once with tags [STAGING, STRATEGIC] as part of the Saved Marker payload.

cases.name: semantic saved marker tag
cases.prompt: Save Jita permanently as a logistics marker.
cases.expectedBehavior: Map the explicit logistics category to the single LOGISTICS initial tag.

cases.name: saved marker no implicit tags
cases.expectedBehavior: Create the Saved Marker with tags=[] and do not infer categories from background knowledge.

cases.name: duplicate saved marker tag protection
cases.prompt: Permanently save this already-saved system again and add the danger tag.
cases.expectedBehavior: Report MARKER_ALREADY_EXISTS and leave the existing marker and all existing tags unchanged.
